content.text: No audit, inspection, or verification right binding Clear Capital exists anywhere in the agreement.

input.quote: (b) Contractor shall bill Company as set forth in the relevant Statement of Work. Each invoice submitted by Contractor will provide supporting detail for the Services invoiced, including, to the extent applicable to a particular engagement, the dates of Services and hours worked at the applicable rate by Statement of Work.
input.rationale: Searches for "audit", "inspect", "verif", "records" and "premises" return no audit, inspection or verification right exercisable against Clear Capital. The compensation section (§ 3) is one-directional: Contractor invoices with supporting detail and Company pays; it grants RadialSpark no right to examine our books, usage or systems, and no other section (§§ 1, 4–7) creates one. Because the agreement imposes no audit obligation on us, there is nothing to limit as to frequency, notice, cost allocation or system access, and the position sits at or above the preferred standard by default. Noted only for the record: since no audit right exists, we also have no negotiated cost-shifting threshold — no change needed, as the absence operates entirely in our favour. If RadialSpark later proposes a compensation-verification or usage-audit right, it should be capped at once per 12 months on 30 days' written notice, conducted off-site by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality, at RadialSpark's cost unless underpayment exceeds 5%, with no direct access to our systems.
